scenes.name: SIX TWO FOUR
lines: Nineteen integer points sit on a sphere of squared radius eight hundred sixty-seven.
十九个非负整点，落在平方半径 867 的球面上。
Lift them to twenty-five states and compare twice along the shortest chords.
把它们提升为二十五态，沿最短弦作两次有序比较。
How many channels appear? Exactly six hundred twenty-four.
会出现多少条通道？恰好 624 条。

scenes.name: COUNTING CHANNELS
lines: Twelve lifted states give four readings each; twelve more give six.
十二个提升态各有 4 种读数，另外十二个各有 6 种。
Squaring: twelve times sixteen plus twelve times thirty-six makes six hundred twenty-four.
两次有序比较把读数个数平方：12 × 16 加 12 × 36，合计 624。
Inverting thresholds generated by this model puts the gain between 623.91 and 624.09.
把这个模型生成的阈值数据拿去反演，增益落在 623.91 与 624.09 之间。

scenes.name: SEVENTEEN TICKS
lines: Along shell edges up to squared length fifty-six, two hundred sixteen channels get stuck.
只沿平方弦长不超过 56 的整数壳边走，有 216 条通道被困住。
Through a grid that cuts the sphere in thirds, all return in nine steps, the fewest possible.
借道球面三分之一细分格，全部通道九步内回程，九步已是下界。
Four hops in, four hops out, nine steps home: a seventeen-tick feedback cycle.
四跳汇合、四跳逆送、九步回程：一个十七拍的反馈周期。
Reuse these edges for mass, old block fixed, and every mass reading goes up.
固定旧传播块、把同样的边拿来传质量，每个质量读数都被抬高。

scenes.name: TWO HIDDEN MODES
lines: Why so rigid? Eliminate two hidden modes with a Schur complement.
为何如此刚硬？用舒尔补消去两个隐藏模式。
The four visible responses become neighbouring products along one chain.
四个可见响应变成同一条链上相邻两项的乘积。
Lean checks exactly which patterns occur. If beta and epsilon are nonzero, gamma cannot vanish.
Lean 内核检验了哪些模式恰好可能出现：β 与 ε 都非零时，γ 不能为零。

scenes.name: THREE CHANNELS
lines: A second Lean theorem: three parallel channels forming a multiple of an isometry.
第二条 Lean 定理：三支通道并联，合起来恰为等距的常数倍。
Squeeze b inputs onto fewer outputs a, and the ratio c over d must drop.
把 b 维输入压到更少的 a 维输出，比值 c/d 就必须下降。
Two thirds, one half, one third, then nothing past three.

scenes.name: MEMORY RANK
lines: How many hidden memory states reproduce the three clocks?
要精确复现三个时钟响应，最少需要多少个辅助记忆态？
Freeze the old nineteen-point block, and you need exactly thirty-eight.
冻结旧的十九点传播块，恰好需要 38 个。
Allow edits up to a cutoff D, and the price falls: twenty-four at three ninety-two, twenty-three at five forty-four.
允许修改平方弦距不超过 D 的旧块条目，代价随之下降：D = 392 时 24，544 时 23。
Then twenty-one, twenty, and a floor of nineteen: replay certificates, not Lean theorems.
再到 21、20，地板是 19：这些是复算证书，不是 Lean 定理。

scenes.name: HURWITZ CORE
lines: Couplings come from Hurwitz words, built on the twenty-four unit core: twelve representatives up to sign.
耦合来自赫维茨四元数的词，建在二十四元单位晶核上：模去正负号剩十二个代表。
Doubled to clear denominators, each has squared norm four. Lean checks this with zero axioms.
坐标加倍消去分母后，每个模方都是 4。Lean 内核在零公理下检验了这一点。
Sixteen-step words reach the box but match no zero; a single matching word needs twenty-one.
16 步的词能进耦合盒，却不匹配任何零点；单独匹配的词要 21 步。

scenes.name: WHO WINS
lines: Which Riemann zero does the model choose? It depends on the criterion.
模型究竟挑中哪一枚黎曼零点？取决于用哪条准则。
Spectral weight, matching volume, port gain, vacuum energy: each crowns a different zero.
谱权、匹配体积、端口增益、真空能：每条准则都把桂冠戴给不同的零点。
With one unread zero on every copy, three copies exactly protect a qutrit.
同一枚未读零点作用于每份副本时，三份副本恰好零误差保护一个三态量子信息。
These witnesses are model-internal; no law yet selects the zero.
这些都只是模型内的见证；仍没有一条定律能选定那枚零点。

scenes.name: LEDGER
lines: Omega Unification, chapter fourteen.
《OMEGA 统一》· 第十四章
